decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out many accessory items like storage cases and charging cables to focus on the actual Bluetooth speakers. My consideration set included the premium Bang & Olufsen A1, the budget-friendly Altec Lansing Mini H2O, the mid-range JBL Clip 3 and Flip 5, and the rugged HyperGear Beast XL. I ultimately chose the JBL Clip 3 in Dusty Pink because it offers an excellent balance of brand reliability, portability, and extremely high consumer ratings (4.7 stars across nearly 69,000 reviews). While the Renewed Flip 5 was a strong contender for better bass, the Clip 3's integrated carabiner and waterproof rating make it more versatile for my needs, and I prefer buying a new unit over a renewed one when the price difference is relatively small.
